## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Safety boundary

- [ ] Original game archives are never modified.
- [ ] No game files, keys, logs, backups, or translation memory are included.
- [ ] New artifacts are independently named and reversible.
- [ ] Third-party licensing was reviewed for newly added dependencies.

## Verification

- [ ] A failing test was observed before changing behavior.
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run audit:repo`
- [ ] Fresh in-game visual check, or clearly marked as outstanding/not applicable.
